name: Linear
description: 在侧栏查看 Linear 议题：我的、当前周期、待办和分拣。按当前 git 分支高亮对应议题，可看状态、子议题、链接和评论，并在 Enso 会话里开始处理。用 Personal API Key，或用 PKCE 登录自建 OAuth 应用（不需要 Client Secret）。

configuration.title: Personal API Key
configuration.description: Linear → 设置 → 账户 → 安全与访问 → Personal API keys。改状态和评论需要读写权限。也可改用侧栏里的 OAuth 登录。

configuration.title: OAuth Client ID（可选）
configuration.description: 自建 Linear OAuth 应用的 Client ID，这是公开标识。回调地址填 http://127.0.0.1:47321/callback。不要填写 Client Secret。

agentTools.name: linear_list
agentTools.description: List Linear issues. view is mine (assigned to you, grouped by status), cycle (the team's active cycle), backlog, or triage. team is a team id or key; omit it on mine to include every team. Optional query filters the fetched rows locally.

team.description: Team id or key, such as ENG

query.description: Local filter on identifier, title, assignee, project, state, or label

agentTools.name: linear_search
agentTools.description: Full-text search Linear issues. Returns identifier, title, status, assignee, and url.

agentTools.name: linear_view
agentTools.description: View one Linear issue by identifier (ENG-123) or UUID, including description, status, sub-issues, links, and comments.

agentTools.name: linear_comment
agentTools.description: Post a comment on a Linear issue.

agentTools.name: linear_update
agentTools.description: Update a Linear issue's status, priority, or assignee. priority is 0 none, 1 urgent, 2 high, 3 medium, 4 low. Pass assigneeId as an empty string to unassign.

assigneeId.description: User UUID, or empty to unassign

agentTools.name: linear_start
agentTools.description: Open a new Enso session to start work on a Linear issue. The prompt includes the identifier, title, description, and suggested git branch.
